title: Review, simulation and profile for skill

blocks.text: The last three weeks of the level serve to consolidate, measure and decide where to work. There's no new grammar. In the first week you review the vocabulary for areas and the grammar framework of B1 and reread the units; in the second, do a complete simulation of the exam , with new texts and in real conditions; in the third build your profile for skills and work on gaps that the simulation showed. In the week 156 support the exam B1 (Part IV).

⁧ضربت عاصفة قوية مساء أمس المدينة الساحلية، مصحوبة بأمطار غزيرة ورياح تجاوزت سرعتها مئة⁩
